newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-COMMERCIAL BANK LOAN RATES FALL IN MARCH.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-COMMERCIAL BANK LOAN RATES FALL IN MARCH.

text.p: The average interest rate on commercial banks' kroon-denominated loans to private individuals and businesses was 11.39 percent in March compared with 11.72 percent in February, the central bank said on Friday.
Average interest rates for kroon loans in March continued to be well down compared to the previous year, when the average was 16.02 percent, the central bank said in a statement.
Average foreign currency rates in March were 8.52 percent versus 9.19 percent in February and 13.81 percent in March 1996.
The average rate on term deposits was also lower at 4.10 percent for kroon deposits compared with 4.95 percent in February and 5.96 percent in March 1996.
